items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: I played with Ullett, once or twice.

ctx.x: Well what kind of music were people playing in those days?

Well, right kind, just any little thing you hear. Yeah. Any little thing you hear, the other fellow play, you catch that. He wasn't playing no, he wasn't with the orchestration music, he wouldn't stand about that. You see? He used to call it parlor music. I used to go to play, there was a fish fry, they said don't play that, put the notes down. They didn't want the notes. You know what I'm saying? They called it parlor music in them times. They wanted the redhead music. And then the little thing you hear. You…
